subject.title: fix(clickclack): add timeouts to REST client requests

question: Should ClickClack permanently use a fixed 30-second completion deadline for JSON REST operations while leaving multipart uploads unbounded, including the resulting ambiguous outcome for timed-out writes?
rationale: Tests and live proof establish that the implementation works, but the timeout value, covered request classes, and retry semantics define owner-specific transport behavior not established by an existing documented contract.

options.title: Approve the current policy
options.body: Accept the fixed 30-second JSON completion deadline and multipart exemption as the ClickClack transport contract.

options.title: Retune before merge
options.body: Choose a different deadline or multipart policy and rerun the controlled-server and focused regression proof.

options.title: Pause for retry design
options.body: Hold the change until ClickClack write idempotency or ambiguous-timeout handling is explicitly defined.

recommendation.title: Approve the current policy
recommendation.body: Accept the fixed 30-second JSON completion deadline and multipart exemption as the ClickClack transport contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available routing signal is recent work on the same client’s timeout policy and gateway failure behavior, though explicit ClickClack ownership is not established.
